notes: Hotmail: MaxCare-format tokens now work. Check Token reads the token only (Live/Die, no sign-in) using each account's own client id. View IMAP reads the mailbox over POP3 when Microsoft blocks IMAP. The recovery-mail one-time code is read reliably again (now taken from the message body), fixing login / Add Recovery 'code did not arrive' and 'incorrect code'. 'Add then Remove Old' shows which old recovery addresses were removed or scheduled. Just Login and Browser login clear Microsoft's privacy-notice page instead of getting stuck.
